    Deterministic path continuations in string presentations #

    The special-biserial continuation conditions make every nonzero path beyond a fixed initial arrow deterministic. This file packages that statement with path length retained, which is the combinatorial input for the uniserial arrow ideals and string modules used in the frozen manuscript.
